description:
Verify on MSRV 1.95 that every AVX2 and AVX-512 intrinsic the bipedal SIMD kernels need is stable, and record the dev host's CPUID flags so the AVX-512 path can be correctly gated.

## Background

CLAUDE.md §Breakdown-time feasibility check requires MSRV verification before SIMD-touching issues are dispatched. The previous `afac2262` incident cost a rework cycle when an AVX-512 ZMM-lane intrinsic turned out to be unstable on MSRV at the time. MSRV is now 1.95, but the verification must still happen.

This issue:

1. Identifies the AVX2 intrinsics needed for bipedal $\mathbb{F}_3$ ops (lane-wise AND/XOR/OR over `__m256i`): `_mm256_and_si256`, `_mm256_xor_si256`, `_mm256_or_si256`, `_mm256_loadu_si256`, `_mm256_storeu_si256`. Confirms all are stable on MSRV 1.95.
2. Identifies the AVX-512 intrinsics needed for the `[aspirational]` AVX-512 path: `_mm512_and_si512`, `_mm512_xor_si512`, `_mm512_or_si512`, `_mm512_loadu_si512`, `_mm512_storeu_si512`. Confirms stability on MSRV 1.95 (or flags any unstable ones for `#[cfg]`-gating with scalar fallback).
3. Records `lscpu` output for the dev host (AMD Ryzen 9 5900X) confirming AVX2 yes, AVX-512 no — which makes AVX-512 paths `[aspirational]` from the SIMD phase onward.
4. Produces a tiny stub Cargo crate under `dev/research/intrinsic_feasibility_stub/` exercising both intrinsic sets and runs `rustup run 1.95.0 cargo check` to verify.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] [hard] `dev/plans/d4_intrinsic_feasibility.md` exists and is attached via `jit doc add`, listing intended AVX2 and AVX-512 intrinsics with stability status on MSRV 1.95.
- [ ] [hard] `rustup run 1.95.0 cargo check` succeeds on the stub crate for both AVX2 and AVX-512 code paths.
- [ ] [hard] The doc records the dev host's `lscpu` AVX flags (AVX2 yes, AVX-512 no on the 5900X) and confirms downstream SIMD issues will gate AVX-512 as `[aspirational]`.
- [ ] [hard] The doc references the prior `afac2262` lesson per CLAUDE.md.
title: MSRV 1.95 intrinsic feasibility for bipedal SIMD kernels
